summary: SCAQMD Rule 222 is the relevant registration-in-lieu-of-written-permit rule, but the facility location is unresolved and Rule 222 only applies within South Coast AQMD jurisdiction. The official rule title/source is “Rule 222 Filing Requirements for Specific Emission Sources Not Requiring a Written Permit Pursuant to Regulation II,” and the official PDF metadata shows it is a South Coast AQMD rule source. For the described project (“coating or paint operation” plus 60 gal flammable solvent storage), I cannot confirm Rule 222 applicability from the available facts because (1) county/jurisdiction is unknown, so SCAQMD may not be the permitting authority, and (2) the provided facts do not identify the exact Rule 222 equipment category, coating type, usage/emissions, or whether the booth is new/modified equipment that otherwise would require a written permit. Treat as indeterminate: if the site is in SCAQMD and the coating operation matches a listed Rule 222 category/conditions, registration filing may substitute for a written permit; otherwise a conventional permit/exemption analysis is needed.
title: H-AIR-222: Rule 222 registration path not confirmed for coating booth/solvent storage without SCAQMD jurisdiction and equipment details
